heading: Security
subheading: Who can reach this workspace, who counts as one of your own people, and what leaves it in a transcript.

accessDenied.title: Access Denied
accessDenied.description: Only workspace Owners and Administrators can view security settings.

loadError.title: Couldn't load security settings
loadError.description: Nothing is shown rather than defaults that are not this workspace's. Retry, and if it keeps failing check that the workspace service is reachable.

toasts.confirmNameMismatch: Confirmation name does not match workspace name.

membership.heading: Membership
membership.decidedByDomain: Decided by verified domain — {domains}. Only addresses on these domains can be invited as internal members.
membership.assignedByHand: Assigned by hand. You choose internal or external for each person you invite.
membership.verifiedDomainsHint: Anyone invited on one of these can be made an internal member. Removing the last one puts membership back to being assigned by hand.
membership.noVerifiedDomains: No verified domains. Only the workspace owner can add one.

allowExternalCollaboration.label: Allow external collaboration
allowExternalCollaboration.hint: Let people outside this workspace join meeting rooms as guests.

invitationExpiry.label: Invitation expiry
invitationExpiry.hint: Days before a workspace invitation link expires (1 - 365 days).

redactPii.label: Redact personal information (PII)
redactPii.hint: Detect and mask sensitive identifiers — emails, phone numbers, ID numbers — before a transcript is stored or translated.

restrictedKeywords.label: Restricted keywords (DLP)
restrictedKeywords.hint: Flag or block designated terms while a meeting is being translated live.

keywordList.label: Keyword list
keywordList.hint: Every word here is checked against each line as it is transcribed.

transferOwnership.label: Transfer ownership
transferOwnership.hint: Hand this workspace to another internal member. You become an Admin, and cannot undo this yourself afterwards.

deleteWorkspace.label: Delete workspace
deleteWorkspace.hint: Ends every membership immediately. Meetings, documents and glossaries go with it. This cannot be undone.

transferDialog.title: Transfer workspace ownership
transferDialog.description: Select a member to become the new owner. Warning: you will be demoted to Admin and cannot undo this action.
transferDialog.confirmWarning: This person becomes Owner immediately; you become Admin. Type their full name to confirm.

deleteDialog.title: Delete workspace
deleteDialog.description: This cannot be undone. It permanently deletes <name></name> and all associated data including documents, members and glossaries.

verifiedDomainsManager.dnsDisclaimer: WarpTalk does not check DNS. Each domain listed here is your organization's assertion that it owns that domain — anyone invited on it can be made an internal member.
verifiedDomainsManager.noDomains: No verified domains. Until one is added, you assign internal and external membership by hand when inviting.
verifiedDomainsManager.selfAssertedTitle: Asserted by the workspace owner. Not verified against DNS.
verifiedDomainsManager.ownerEmailTitle: Matches the workspace owner's own email domain.
verifiedDomainsManager.selfAssertedConsentIntro: WarpTalk does not verify domain ownership. Adding {domain} records your organization's assertion that it owns this domain.
verifiedDomainsManager.selfAssertedConsentConfirm: Confirm that your organization owns {domain}, and that you understand anyone invited with an @{domain} address can be assigned Internal membership.
verifiedDomainsManager.lastDomainRevokeIntro: {domain} is the last verified domain for this workspace.
verifiedDomainsManager.lastDomainRevokeDetail: Revoking it stops membership being decided by email domain: from then on you assign Internal and External by hand when inviting. Members who are already Internal keep their access.

toasts.publicDomainRefused: Public email domains cannot be verified as company domains.
toasts.revoked: {domain} is no longer a verified domain.
